name: ob1-rest-client
comment: The REST core's typed client (SMD-2287): openapi-fetch over the types openapi-typescript generates from the REST core's own OpenAPI document. `bun generate.ts` writes openapi.json, schema.d.ts and operations.ts from server-portable/rest/openapi.ts; `bun test-client.ts` fails when any is stale. Both pinned exactly: a generator bump changes schema.d.ts, which is a PR that regenerates it. The MCP server as a REST client (SMD-2287, to come in mcp-server/) and the operator GUI (SMD-2280) call the REST core through it. The type pins move with server-portable's (check 18).
